text: {"lessons":["My account has fluctuated modestly overall, but a losing month reminds me to prioritize preserving savings and limiting risk over chasing gains.","Selling Stock A after a steep loss does not show that I can time a recovery; I should assess its outlook and my portfolio risk rather than react only to the loss.","My occasional partial sales have kept trading measured; I should avoid frequent changes and keep my investments appropriate for retirement income."]}
